problems.note: Step 1 says Maya has 43 stickers but the picture is a single ⭐. One star doesn't show 43 of anything, so the picture and narration don't match. A ten-frame or a row of 20 stars with a count would fit the 43 stickers better.

450 to the nearest hundred is an exactly-halfway case. The answer 500 follows the 5-or-more-rounds-up rule in the story, so it is correct, but halfway cases are a convention and may confuse a Grade 3 child. Consider using a non-halfway number here, or saying in the story that 5 rounds up.

550 to the nearest hundred is also an exactly-halfway case. The answer 600 is right under the story's rule, but it is the same convention issue as keypad-4. Consider a clearer example, or keep it and make the 5-rounds-up rule explicit.

The question asks for the nearest hundred but offers 370 as a choice. 370 is a nearest-ten answer, so it is a distractor that could mislead a child who has just learned tens. It is not marked wrong, so this is only a teaching-clarity note.
